output.summary: A large perennial fern found throughout Asia and Oceania, it has an upright rhizome covered in short reddish-brown scales. Its long brownish leaf stalks have black, scaly bases. Young fronds are stir-fried or used in salads; they may contain mild fern toxins, though no major toxic effects are recorded.
